summary.text: Randyn Gregg is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 78 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Gregg earned a degree from Montana State University in 2015, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner.
He took office on January 6, 2025, and for 2025-2026 is vice chair of the House Education Committee and a member of the Fish, Wildlife and Parks and Taxation committees.
